name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Allows two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a shared purpose while protecting that information from unauthorized use or disclosure.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Governs the sale and purchase of cloud-hosted software or SaaS products, covering access and use of the service, support, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Gives an early customer or design partner access to a product in exchange for feedback that helps the provider develop and improve the product before general release.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Defines uptime and support response time commitments for a cloud service, along with the service credits and remedies available if those targets are missed. Used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Governs the provision of professional or consulting services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, fees, warranties, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Sets out how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incident response, and audit rights, to support GDPR and other data protection compliance.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Grants a customer a license to install and use on-premises or self-hosted software, covering license scope, updates, open source components, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Governs a business partnership between two companies, including each party's obligations, trademark licensing for co-marketing, fees, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product or service before committing to a longer-term commercial contract.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-required agreement between a covered entity and a business associate that governs the use, disclosure, and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI).

name: AI Addendum
description: Supplements an underlying agreement to govern the use of AI features, including input and output ownership, model training restrictions, and disclaimers specific to AI-generated content.
